# Frontend Design

## When to use
- Build a landing page for a product or service
- Design a modern homepage for a government-tech or public-sector platform
- Create hero sections, feature grids, CTA blocks, and product storytelling

## Goals
- Communicate value clearly and quickly
- Make the product feel credible, modern, and trustworthy
- Use a compelling visual hierarchy and strong CTA flow

## Design system
- Use deep navy, teal, cyan, and white as the base palette
- Favor generous spacing, rounded cards, and subtle shadows
- Keep text scannable with short headings and clear CTAs
- Maintain a premium but accessible look

## Landing page structure
1. Hero section
2. Problem statement
3. Solution overview
4. Core features
5. Metrics and outcomes
6. Workflow steps
7. Public transparency section
8. Final CTA

## Writing guidance
- Lead with the user problem
- Position the product as a digital governance solution
- Emphasize trust, transparency, youth engagement, and accountability
- Use concise, action-oriented copy

## Quality bar
- Responsive layout
- Visual clarity
- Strong first impression
- Professional civic-tech branding
- Conversion-focused sections without clutter
